'''Kilit Four''' was the callsign of a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Kilit Squadron]] of the Sith Empire. During the [[Battle of Corellia]] the squadron participated in the attack on the [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City's]] [[Aegis Base]], during which Kilit Four started losing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] engine power and was ordered to return to base lest he got shot down like [[Kilit Three]].
